notes.title: Halloween Run Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34684901/52caed7d10b7949e2684ffa8e69a29d5bdd35753.png[/img]

The Halloween run is here! Join other players to become the fastest Ninja completing the spookiest level!

Include a series of new harzards and objects:

- Demon Ninja enemies! Nervous, vicious and more unpredictable!
- Pumpkins! Push them or make them explode!
- Fire Ghost! They might give you chills at first glance, but expect the opposite!
- Bouncy floating bricks!

Enjoy the update and Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Speedrun Ninja - Release + FAQ Notes!
notes.content:
[b]Speedrun Ninja is live now featuring 3 different runs[/b] and leader boards plus achievements. At this moment there is one person who has already purchased the game. I have to tell you thanks! Thanks to be the first one on trusting and giving me a chance! I don't know who you are, but from now on I will name you Ichi ([b]壱[/b]) <3

I got already some questions regarding the game and further development on Discord and Youtube. So here you have the answers to those FAQ:

[list]
[*] [b]Q: Will you add more runs in the future?[/b]
[*] A: Yes, I plan to make at least two more seasonal updates, Halloween will be definitely one of those!

[*] [b]Q: Will you add a level editor / share?[/b]
[*] A: Depends on how is the game received and the demand. Creating a level editor should be feasible, but there is no easy way for me to create a system to share those on the fly. Still one could save and share the files on the internet. Something that I could do then is add the most popular levels to new official game runs, and credit the authors.
[/list]

notes.title: Pre-Release Update
notes.content:
Hi there!
Game will release soon! And I am making the final updates based on your feedback.

Minor bugs were updated and the challenge for the Classic Run got intensified!
Now will be a bit harder to finish some levels of the run and set a good record. But also will make it more fun to beat!

Remember! All the leader boards will be reset on release... so, keep training your skills since you will have to defend your record once the game goes live!

notes.title: Second Beta Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed Physics Issues with collision - now really!
[*] Increased the speed of the game.
[*] Improved air-control of the character.
[*] Fixed Camera movement issue when jumping.
[*] Added quick restart function for a level (you don't need to suicide any longer!): R on keyboard or Xbox pad Y button.
[/list]

notes.title: First Beta Update
notes.content:
[b][u]Two big improvements on the game experience:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Physics Improved[/b]: Now the player will stop entering in dynamic objects when colliding against them at high speed (but probably not at speed of sound or higher).

[*] [b]Control Mechanics updated[/b]: Now double jump gets always activated after colliding with any valid surface. The first jump will not deactivate if the player happens to bounce after the collision. Translated to player experience: jump mechanics [strike]feel [/strike] are consistent and predictable now :)
[/list]
